terminal_name: New Fortress Energy 'FLNG 2' (NOT a Puerto Rico terminal)
issue: Some 2025-2026 press loosely calls NFE's 'second installation'/'FLNG 2' a Puerto Rico project (e.g. a search snippet implying construction completing H1 2026 in PR). VERIFIED: NFE's FLNG 2 floating liquefaction unit is at Altamira, Mexico (with CFE), funded by a $700M loan closed 2025 — it is a Mexico EXPORT/liquefaction asset, not a Puerto Rico import terminal. No new PR terminal here. Flagging so the conflation does not seed a false PR add; the unit belongs to Mexico scope.
suggested_action: Do not stage as a Puerto Rico terminal. Confirm FLNG 2 (Altamira, Mexico) is covered under Mexico in GEM during a Mexico/Americas pass.

issue: Confirmed San Juan (NFEnergia, Wharves A&B, Port of San Juan) is GEM's existing operating terminal. Active 2024-2026 developments around it are operational/regulatory, not new terminals: FERC San Juan Micro-Fuel Handling Facility EIS (NEPA review of the existing terminal, jurisdiction litigation upheld 2025); USACE ~$59M San Juan Bay channel dredging to admit larger tankers; the Dec-2025 multi-site LNG supply contract (NFEnergia, via 3PPO-RFP-1125-17-MSIN; only NFE and Crowley LNG PR bid); and a new 450 MW gas combined-cycle power plant let to a Tropigas + Cratos Energy Holdings consortium with NFE supplying gas. None is a distinct new import/export TERMINAL; they route to Update (status/capacity refresh of San Juan) if GEM is stale, not Discovery.
suggested_action: Route any San Juan capacity/status/ownership refresh to an Update batch (e.g. FERC EIS outcome, dredging-driven capacity changes). No new terminal to add.

issue: Confirmed EcoElectrica / Punta Guayanilla (Penuelas) is GEM's existing operating southern terminal serving Costa Sur. Crowley's PR LNG activity (Penuelas LNG loading terminal, ~94M gal/yr; Isla Grande container terminal; reflagged US LNG carrier 'American Energy' with Naturgy; ISO-container LNG distribution) is shipping/distribution logistics tied to the existing Penuelas facility and to inbound supply, NOT a new import/export terminal. No new terminal here.
suggested_action: No action; existing terminal. Crowley logistics are out of terminal scope (distribution/bunkering-adjacent).
